proof_states.proves: The configured remote default branch contains the intended commit.
proof_states.does_not_prove: Any local checkout, production/use path, or operator entrypoint is current.

proof_states.proves: The registered canonical development checkout resolves to the intended commit with preserved local work.
proof_states.does_not_prove: The production/use path has been updated.

proof_states.proves: The registered installed/served/field runtime was derived or updated from the intended commit and its owning verification passed.
proof_states.does_not_prove: The real operator entrypoint is observing that runtime.

proof_states.proves: The real registered operator entrypoint resolves the intended production/use path and current identity.
proof_states.does_not_prove: A product deployment or live target outcome succeeded.

profiles.purpose: Normal mutable development and repository maintenance.

canonical_development_checkout.currentness: git identity plus refreshed remote comparison

production_use_path.reason: Development-only profile; product-specific production/use paths are owned by a field or application profile.

temporary_worktree_root.purpose: Collision-isolated branch/worktree execution without creating a second canonical clone.

real_operator_entrypoint.resolution: Select the task's registered command/front door only after canonical-path and freshness proof.

profiles.purpose: Admin workstation development plus sealed field-runtime use.

canonical_development_checkout.currentness: git identity plus refreshed remote comparison

production_use_path.purpose: Short sealed AutoLogon field runtime staged by the owning refresh/bootstrap workflow.
production_use_path.currentness: sealed runtime manifest and owning runtime-seal verification

temporary_worktree_root.purpose: Isolated repository work only; never the installed field runtime.

real_operator_entrypoint.resolution: Operator execution routing selects the registered front door and proves the resolved path before execution.

operator_command_safety.reason: PowerShell parses a separately submitted else as a new command; multi-line operator instructions must preserve complete control-flow blocks.

proof_ceiling: Path identity and separation proof only. This registry does not prove repository freshness by itself, does not update a workstation, does not stage a field runtime, and does not prove a live deployment or target outcome.
